vlog_arc.theme: Building something real means showing the week as it actually is

beats.mon: Leo opens the week at 5am, formula in hand, naming the one thing he wants to prove to himself by Friday — not to the camera, to himself.
beats.tue: Leo walks through a formulation decision he had to make this week and explains, calmly, why the cheaper option was the wrong one — no drama, just the reasoning.
beats.wed: Midweek check-in: Leo shares one metric that moved and one that didn't, and says out loud what most founders only admit in private — progress is slower than the content looks.
beats.thu: Leo films a quiet moment with Gabriel after school and reflects on one sentence — that whatever he's building has to be worth the hours it takes away from moments like this.
beats.fri: Leo closes the workweek by naming what the numbers actually said, what the plan for next week is, and why he's at peace with both — calm, grounded, no performance.
beats.sat: Leo is training — running or swimming — and speaks one thought mid-effort: that the same discipline that gets him to mile six is what keeps him publishing when the results aren't visible yet.
beats.sun: Leo sits down, unhurried, and says what he's grateful for this week — one line about the business, one about family, one about something he learned — then closes the camera.
